items.title: Free for Dev
items.content_text:
### APIs, Data, and ML

*   [DocSpring](https://docspring.com) - Fill out PDF forms, generate PDFs and Word documents, and collect e-signatures. Free developer plan includes unlimited test PDFs and 10 filled PDFs per month. Up to 10 templates, 2 users, and 2 integrations. No credit card required and no time limits.

### Security and PKI

*   [CertAvert](https://certavert.com/monitoring) - Monitor SSL/TLS certificates on any port, checks expiry, chain problems, revocation, host mismatch. Monitor 15 domains free, get expiry notifications, email, Slack or Discord. No credit card required for signup.

### Email

*   [mxRaven](https://mxraven.com/) - Programmable inbound email infrastructure with webhook, forward, and auto-reply routing, plus a durable pull-based event stream for consuming mail without a public endpoint. Free tier includes 1,000 outbound and 1,000 inbound tasks per month, 1 workspace, and 1 domain.

items.title: Static Analysis
items.content_text:
### Multiple languages / [Other](#other-1)

*   [Kin (⭐68)](https://github.com/kinlab-ai/kin) — A graph-native code repository for people and AI agents. Kin parses supported languages into code entities and their relationships (calls, references, imports, inheritance) and versions them with the source. The kin CLI and an MCP server query the same graph for callers, references, traces and what a change might affect. Imports existing Git history. Public beta.

items.title: Awesome Docker
items.content_text:

*   [nginx-lua (⭐228)](https://github.com/fabiocicerchia/nginx-lua) - Latest Nginx with LuaJIT on six base distros (Alma, Alpine, Amazon, Debian, Fedora, Ubuntu).

*   [groundcover](https://www.groundcover.com/) - :yen: Monitor Docker containers via an eBPF host sensor — logs, metrics, traces, and APM, deployed inside the user's own cloud (BYOC).
*   [metriclens (⭐2)](https://github.com/tyshkovskii/metriclens) - Auto-discovers Prometheus metrics endpoints across Docker Compose services and visualizes them in a local web UI.

### Where to Start / Wrappers

*   [Docker Terminal Simulator](https://devops-daily.com/games/docker-terminal-simulator): Guided Docker lessons in a simulated terminal in the browser. Free and open source, no signup.

items.title: Awesome Chatgpt Prompts
items.content_text:
### 🤖 Bots & Bot Teams

*   **[Bots](https://prompts.chat/bots)** — Share and discover bots (OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Grok Bot, and more). Each bot page has install instructions per platform, the computer it needs (**cloud**, **the user's computer**, or **both**), "Better together with" pairings, upvotes, comments, and change requests.
*   **[Bot Teams](https://prompts.chat/bots/teams)** — Groups of bots that hand work off to each other, shown as an interactive graph. Upvote a team or install every bot in it at once. Featured teams appear on the homepage, and **Teams** is in the top navigation.
*   **Profiles** — User profiles have Bots and Teams tabs with counts.
*   **Moderation** — Bots and teams can be unlisted to hide them from public listings.

items.title: Awesome Integration
items.content_text:
### Projects / AI Gateway

*   [agentgateway (⭐5.8k) (⭐5.4k)](https://github.com/agentgateway/agentgateway) - An open-source data plane for agentic AI connectivity, providing security, observability, and governance for agent-to-tool (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication.
*   [Bifrost (⭐9.2k) (⭐9.2k)](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost) - A high-performance AI gateway written in Go that unifies more than 20 model providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible API, with failover, load balancing, semantic caching, and governance.
*   [Envoy AI Gateway (⭐2.3k) (⭐2.3k)](https://github.com/envoyproxy/ai-gateway) - An open-source gateway built on Envoy Proxy to manage request traffic from application clients to GenAI services with unified API access and usage limits.
*   [IBM ContextForge (⭐4.7k) (⭐4.7k)](https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge) - An AI gateway, registry, and proxy that federates MCP, A2A, and REST services behind a single endpoint with governance and observability.
*   [LiteLLM (⭐62k) (⭐62k)](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm) - An LLM gateway that exposes 100+ model providers through a unified OpenAI-compatible API, with spend tracking, fallbacks, and rate limiting.

### Projects / API Design

*   [Zally (⭐945) (⭐946)](https://github.com/zalando/zally) - Ensure the quality of your OpenAPI specs with this linter tool that provides extensive analysis and feedback.

### Projects / API Documentation

*   [Zudoku (⭐613) (⭐606)](https://github.com/zuplo/zudoku) - A customizable framework built on OpenAPI, focused on delivering exceptional developer experiences through quality documentation.

### Projects / API Gateway

*   [Apache ShenYu (⭐8.9k) (⭐8.9k)](https://github.com/apache/shenyu) - A Java-native gateway excelling in protocol conversion, service proxying, and comprehensive API governance.
*   [Envoy Gateway (⭐3.1k) (⭐3.1k)](https://github.com/envoyproxy/gateway) - CNCF Envoy-based gateway with Gateway API, mTLS, JWT, and other built-ins.
*   [KrakenD API Gateway (⭐2.7k) (⭐2.7k)](https://github.com/krakend/krakend-ce) - An ultra-high performance gateway with efficient middleware configuration, robust security, and seamless scaling.

### Projects / API Management

*   [Gravitee.io API Management (⭐466) (⭐461)](https://github.com/gravitee-io/gravitee-api-management) - A lightweight, open-source platform offering flexible API governance, robust security, and straightforward configuration.

### Projects / B2B Integration

*   [phase4 (⭐246) (⭐245)](https://github.com/phax/phase4) - Embeddable, lightweight Java library implementing the AS4 messaging protocol, including the Peppol and CEF/eDelivery profiles.

### Projects / Business Rules Engine

*   [OpenL Tablets (⭐210) (⭐208)](https://github.com/openl-tablets/openl-tablets) - Flexible open-source decision management system that simplifies defining and executing business rules and decision tables.
*   [ZEN Engine (⭐2.1k) (⭐2.1k)](https://github.com/gorules/zen) - A cross-platform, open-source Business Rules Engine written in Rust that executes JSON Decision Models through interconnected graphs of decision tables, functions, and expressions.

### Projects / Data Integration

*   [Conduit (⭐618) (⭐617)](https://github.com/ConduitIO/conduit) - Lightweight data integration tool written in Go that streams data between systems using built-in or standalone connectors, with Kafka Connect compatibility.
*   [dlt (⭐6k) (⭐6k)](https://github.com/dlt-hub/dlt) - Open-source Python library for building data pipelines as code, with schema evolution and incremental loading out of the box.
*   [Estuary Flow (⭐986) (⭐983)](https://github.com/estuary/flow) - Versatile, scalable platform that provides both real-time and batch data integration for ETL and ELT pipelines.
*   [Sling (⭐919) (⭐917)](https://github.com/slingdata-io/sling-cli) - Fast ELT command-line tool and Go library for moving data between databases, files, and cloud storage across a wide set of connectors.

### Projects / Data Mapping Solution

*   [Kaoto (⭐131) (⭐130)](https://github.com/KaotoIO/kaoto) - Visual data mapper for Apache Camel with a drag-and-drop interface supporting XML, JSON, CSV, and XSLT transformations. Successor to AtlasMap.

### Projects / Enterprise Service Bus

*   [WSO2 Integrator: MI (⭐288) (⭐265)](https://github.com/wso2/product-integrator-mi) - The configuration-driven integration runtime of the WSO2 Integrator platform, supporting enterprise integration patterns in centralised and containerised deployments.

### Projects / Integration Frameworks

*   [Wolverine (⭐2.4k) (⭐2.4k)](https://github.com/JasperFx/wolverine) - Low-ceremony messaging and command-bus framework for .NET with built-in durable messaging and transports like RabbitMQ and Kafka.

### Projects / Integration Platform as a Service

*   [Camel K (⭐935) (⭐934)](https://github.com/apache/camel-k) - Lightweight Kubernetes-native integration platform built on Apache Camel that runs integration routes directly on Kubernetes and OpenShift as cloud-native serverless services.

### Projects / Message Broker

*   [Apache Iggy (⭐5.2k) (⭐5.2k)](https://github.com/apache/iggy) - Persistent message streaming platform written in Rust, supporting QUIC, TCP, and HTTP transports with high throughput and low latency.

### Projects / Robotic Process Automation

*   [OpenRPA (⭐3.1k) (⭐3.1k)](https://github.com/open-rpa/openrpa) - Enterprise-grade, open-source robotic process automation suite.

### Projects / Schema Registry

*   [Apicurio Registry (⭐948) (⭐944)](https://github.com/Apicurio/apicurio-registry) - Open-source registry for API designs and schemas, supporting Avro, Protobuf, JSON Schema, OpenAPI, and AsyncAPI artifacts with configurable compatibility rules.
*   [Karapace (⭐641) (⭐640)](https://github.com/Aiven-Open/karapace) - Open-source, drop-in replacement for Confluent Schema Registry and the Kafka REST API.

### Projects / Self-Service Integration

*   [n8n (⭐209k) (⭐208k)](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n) - Open-source workflow automation tool with 400+ connectors, giving you full control over your data and integrations.

### Projects / Stream Processing

*   [Apache Beam (⭐8.7k) (⭐8.7k)](https://github.com/apache/beam) - Unified programming model for batch and streaming pipelines, portable across runners such as Flink, Spark, and Google Cloud Dataflow.

### Projects / Workflow Engine

*   [Inngest (⭐6k) (⭐6k)](https://github.com/inngest/inngest) - Event-driven durable execution platform that runs reliable step functions inside your existing services.
*   [Kestra (⭐30k) (⭐30k)](https://github.com/kestra-io/kestra) - Event-driven declarative orchestrator with workflows defined in YAML and hundreds of plugins for data and infrastructure automation.
*   [LittleHorse (⭐401) (⭐400)](https://github.com/littlehorse-enterprises/littlehorse) - High-throughput, low-latency microservice orchestration engine built on Kafka Streams, with SDKs in multiple languages.
*   [Restate (⭐4.6k) (⭐4.6k)](https://github.com/restatedev/restate) - Durable execution engine for building resilient workflows, event-driven services, and stateful handlers as plain code.
*   [Temporal (⭐24k) (⭐24k)](https://github.com/temporalio/temporal) - Open-source workflow-as-code platform designed for building reliable, scalable, and fault-tolerant applications.

### Resources / API Specification

*   [Arazzo Specification (⭐488) (⭐482)](https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification) - A standard, programming language-agnostic representation for describing sequences of API calls (workflows) and their dependencies.
*   [TypeSpec (⭐5.9k) (⭐5.9k)](https://github.com/microsoft/typespec) - A highly extensible language for describing API data shapes and protocols, capable of compiling to OpenAPI, JSON Schema, Protobuf, and other formats.

### Resources / Data Formats

*   [YAML (⭐506) (⭐504)](https://github.com/yaml/yaml-spec) - A human-friendly and easy-to-read data serialization format that is widely used for configuration files and data exchange. It supports rich data types and is compatible with most programming languages.

### Resources / Structure and Validation

*   [JSON Schema (⭐5.2k) (⭐5.2k)](https://github.com/json-schema-org/json-schema-spec) - A powerful tool for validating the structure of JSON data. JSON Schema enables developers to ensure that JSON data conforms to a specific structure, making it easier to process and manipulate.

  • Envoy AI Gateway (⭐2.3k) (⭐2.3k) - An open-source gateway built on Envoy Proxy to manage request traffic from application clients to GenAI services with unified API access and usage limits.
  • IBM ContextForge (⭐4.7k) (⭐4.7k) - An AI gateway, registry, and proxy that federates MCP, A2A, and REST services behind a single endpoint with governance and observability.
  • LiteLLM (⭐62k) (⭐62k) - An LLM gateway that exposes 100+ model providers through a unified OpenAI-compatible API, with spend tracking, fallbacks, and rate limiting.

Projects / API Design

  • Zally (⭐945) (⭐946) - Ensure the quality of your OpenAPI specs with this linter tool that provides extensive analysis and feedback.

Projects / API Documentation

  • Zudoku (⭐613) (⭐606) - A customizable framework built on OpenAPI, focused on delivering exceptional developer experiences through quality documentation.

Projects / API Gateway

  • Apache ShenYu (⭐8.9k) (⭐8.9k) - A Java-native gateway excelling in protocol conversion, service proxying, and comprehensive API governance.
  • Envoy Gateway (⭐3.1k) (⭐3.1k) - CNCF Envoy-based gateway with Gateway API, mTLS, JWT, and other built-ins.
  • KrakenD API Gateway (⭐2.7k) (⭐2.7k) - An ultra-high performance gateway with efficient middleware configuration, robust security, and seamless scaling.

Projects / API Management

  • Gravitee.io API Management (⭐466) (⭐461) - A lightweight, open-source platform offering flexible API governance, robust security, and straightforward configuration.

Projects / B2B Integration

  • phase4 (⭐246) (⭐245) - Embeddable, lightweight Java library implementing the AS4 messaging protocol, including the Peppol and CEF/eDelivery profiles.

Projects / Business Rules Engine

  • OpenL Tablets (⭐210) (⭐208) - Flexible open-source decision management system that simplifies defining and executing business rules and decision tables.
  • ZEN Engine (⭐2.1k) (⭐2.1k) - A cross-platform, open-source Business Rules Engine written in Rust that executes JSON Decision Models through interconnected graphs of decision tables, functions, and expressions.

Projects / Data Integration

  • Conduit (⭐618) (⭐617) - Lightweight data integration tool written in Go that streams data between systems using built-in or standalone connectors, with Kafka Connect compatibility.
  • dlt (⭐6k) (⭐6k) - Open-source Python library for building data pipelines as code, with schema evolution and incremental loading out of the box.
  • Estuary Flow (⭐986) (⭐983) - Versatile, scalable platform that provides both real-time and batch data integration for ETL and ELT pipelines.
  • Sling (⭐919) (⭐917) - Fast ELT command-line tool and Go library for moving data between databases, files, and cloud storage across a wide set of connectors.

Projects / Data Mapping Solution

  • Kaoto (⭐131) (⭐130) - Visual data mapper for Apache Camel with a drag-and-drop interface supporting XML, JSON, CSV, and XSLT transformations. Successor to AtlasMap.

Projects / Enterprise Service Bus

  • WSO2 Integrator: MI (⭐288) (⭐265) - The configuration-driven integration runtime of the WSO2 Integrator platform, supporting enterprise integration patterns in centralised and containerised deployments.

Projects / Integration Frameworks

  • Wolverine (⭐2.4k) (⭐2.4k) - Low-ceremony messaging and command-bus framework for .NET with built-in durable messaging and transports like RabbitMQ and Kafka.

Projects / Integration Platform as a Service

  • Camel K (⭐935) (⭐934) - Lightweight Kubernetes-native integration platform built on Apache Camel that runs integration routes directly on Kubernetes and OpenShift as cloud-native serverless services.

Projects / Message Broker

  • Apache Iggy (⭐5.2k) (⭐5.2k) - Persistent message streaming platform written in Rust, supporting QUIC, TCP, and HTTP transports with high throughput and low latency.

Projects / Robotic Process Automation

  • OpenRPA (⭐3.1k) (⭐3.1k) - Enterprise-grade, open-source robotic process automation suite.

Projects / Schema Registry

  • Apicurio Registry (⭐948) (⭐944) - Open-source registry for API designs and schemas, supporting Avro, Protobuf, JSON Schema, OpenAPI, and AsyncAPI artifacts with configurable compatibility rules.
  • Karapace (⭐641) (⭐640) - Open-source, drop-in replacement for Confluent Schema Registry and the Kafka REST API.

Projects / Self-Service Integration

  • n8n (⭐209k) (⭐208k) - Open-source workflow automation tool with 400+ connectors, giving you full control over your data and integrations.

Projects / Stream Processing

  • Apache Beam (⭐8.7k) (⭐8.7k) - Unified programming model for batch and streaming pipelines, portable across runners such as Flink, Spark, and Google Cloud Dataflow.

Projects / Workflow Engine

  • Inngest (⭐6k) (⭐6k) - Event-driven durable execution platform that runs reliable step functions inside your existing services.
  • Kestra (⭐30k) (⭐30k) - Event-driven declarative orchestrator with workflows defined in YAML and hundreds of plugins for data and infrastructure automation.
  • LittleHorse (⭐401) (⭐400) - High-throughput, low-latency microservice orchestration engine built on Kafka Streams, with SDKs in multiple languages.
  • Restate (⭐4.6k) (⭐4.6k) - Durable execution engine for building resilient workflows, event-driven services, and stateful handlers as plain code.
  • Temporal (⭐24k) (⭐24k) - Open-source workflow-as-code platform designed for building reliable, scalable, and fault-tolerant applications.

Resources / API Specification

  • Arazzo Specification (⭐488) (⭐482) - A standard, programming language-agnostic representation for describing sequences of API calls (workflows) and their dependencies.
  • TypeSpec (⭐5.9k) (⭐5.9k) - A highly extensible language for describing API data shapes and protocols, capable of compiling to OpenAPI, JSON Schema, Protobuf, and other formats.

Resources / Data Formats

  • YAML (⭐506) (⭐504) - A human-friendly and easy-to-read data serialization format that is widely used for configuration files and data exchange. It supports rich data types and is compatible with most programming languages.

Resources / Structure and Validation

  • JSON Schema (⭐5.2k) (⭐5.2k) - A powerful tool for validating the structure of JSON data. JSON Schema enables developers to ensure that JSON data conforms to a specific structure, making it easier to process and manipulate.

items.title: Awesome Zsh Plugins
items.content_text:
### Plugins / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [claude-code (⭐16)](https://github.com/matheus-poli/zsh-claude-code) - Adds `ask` and `explain` commands plus Ctrl+X (rewrite a natural-language request into a command, in place) and Alt+E (explain the typed command) widgets, built on the Claude Code CLI with tools and MCP servers disabled.
*   [fasd (⭐112)](https://github.com/whjvenyl/fasd) - A command-line productivity booster. Fasd offers quick access to files and directories for POSIX shells. It is inspired by tools like [autojump (⭐17k)](https://github.com/joelthelion/autojump), [z (⭐17k)](http://github.com/rupa/z) and [v (⭐459)](https://github.com/rupa/v). Fasd keeps track of files and directories you have accessed, so that you can quickly reference them in the command line.

### ZSH Tools / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [oops (⭐2)](https://github.com/ysb3996-blip/oops) - Copies the last command and its output to the clipboard as a Markdown code block, with API keys and other secrets masked. Works in ZSH and `bash`. Installed as a Ruby gem (Ruby 3.3 or later).

items.title: Awesome Testing
items.content_text:
### Software / AI & LLM Testing

*   [Bite (⭐1)](https://github.com/connabyss/bite) - Open-source CLI that checks whether recent "fixed" commits are really guarded by tests: it takes each fix back out and runs the project's own tests to see if any fail. Free mode needs no API key.

### Software / Service Virtualization

*   [ghostwire (⭐0)](https://github.com/nanmuyao-tools/ghostwire) - Open-source Linux tool that mocks ping, TCP connections, UDP errors and DNS per target address, with delay, jitter, loss and faults controllable live through an HTTP API; no proxy to point your program at, no root needed under `exec`.

### Software / Accessibility & Usability Testing

*   [Persqo](https://persqo.com) - Runs AI personas (different ages, devices and patience levels) through a live web app in a real browser and returns ranked issues with screenshots and severity, plus ready-to-paste fix prompts for your coding agent. 3 free test sessions, no card; paid plans from $59/month.

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### Commands & Extensions

*   [Kin (⭐1)](https://github.com/kinlab-ai/kin-plugin) - Gemini CLI extension for Kin: use your accounts from Gemini CLI, even two of one service, each with its own rule per action (Allow, Ask me or Block), through Kin's hosted MCP server. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/kinlab-ai/kin-plugin`.
*   [vidbyte-memory (⭐2)](https://github.com/cerredz/vidbyte-memory) - Gemini CLI extension and GitHub template for correction-driven memory: corrections become facts Gemini loads, pytest tests where a check can be written, and git commits, and the installer adds an `AfterAgent` hook that sends Gemini back to work (up to 5 times in a row) while tests fail.

### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [Railse (⭐2)](https://github.com/xufei547/railse-opc) - Self-hosted approval inbox for Gemini CLI, Claude Code and Codex: hooks route every tool call through risk-based rules; for Gemini CLI that means deny rules plus phone notifications for questions and completion, with approvals from the phone for Claude Code and Codex.

### MCP Servers

*   [JobsPipe](https://jobspipe.dev/mcp-server?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Hosted MCP server and Gemini CLI extension for live job postings from 30+ ATS feeds and job boards in one normalized schema: search by role, place, date, salary, seniority, skills and visa stance, read a posting in full, and save searches as alerts. OAuth sign-in or API key, free plan. `gemini extensions install https://github.com/jobspipe/mcp`.
